body:
FOUND BY THE 2026-08-05 AUDIT (fresh-operator journey + report-honesty lens, each CONFIRMED with the exact command). The overall newcomer experience measured GOOD — errors mostly name their cure; these are the exceptions. One ticket, six itemized criteria; each is small and independent.

1. A malformed Schema Policy refuses with rhizomatic's bare parse error: `expected object for order` — no prop path, no expected shape. README shows Policy kinds `pick / all / merge` but only ever specifies pick's JSON. Wrap parse failures at the register door with the prop path (schema.props.<name>) and the expected shape; document each Policy kind's JSON in README. (src/gateway/registration.ts)
2. `loam store --home ./nowhere` prints a raw `ENOENT ... nowhere/config.json`. Catch it; refuse naming `loam init`. (src/cli/cli.ts)
3. `loam artifact --help`: long option names overrun the padding column and concatenate with their descriptions (`--acknowledge-writableyes, I know...`); and --connector is required but listed as ordinary. Widen/wrap the column; mark required. (src/cli/cli.ts)
4. After a pull lands a peer's definitions, the empty-surface refusal (`nothing is registered: the gateway has no queryable surface yet`) stops one sentence short: when the store HOLDS definitions that do not bind (foreign law inert), say so and name `loam register` / POST /:mount/register as the cure. (src/gateway/gql.ts)
5. The admin federate result page counts an IN-PASTE duplicate as "already held" — held by the store is not the same fact as repeated in your paste; the report is wrong about which. Count them separately or name the union honestly. (src/server/admin.ts — mind the frozen admin rails; new assertions go in a new file)
6. README names `.adlc/tickets.json` twice (the organization section and the backlog note); the store is the sharded `.adlc/tickets/` directory. Fix both. (README.md)

RAILS: one new test file per touched surface, asserting the improved message VERBATIM enough to go red on regression; README claims are doc edits with no rail beyond review.

WHO MERGES: ordinary bar — every item makes a report more honest or a doc more true; none widens a door.
title: Newcomer paper-cuts, itemized: six places the polish slips on the documented path
